profile.headline: AFROTECH 2026 | FDSE @ Palantir Technologies | Building Data-Driven Applications
profile.summary:
Software Engineer and AI/ML practitioner with a foundation in Computer and Electrical Engineering from New York Institute of Technology, currently completing an M.S. in Data Science.

I recently joined Palantir Technologies as a Forward Deployed Engineer, where I work directly with customers to solve complex, high-stakes problems through data and software. Before Palantir, I spent three years at Northrop Grumman designing and implementing cross-platform GUIs, containerized applications, and data pipelines using Python, React, FastAPI, Elasticsearch, and Postgres.

My work sits at the intersection of engineering and data. I'm drawn to building systems that make complex information actionable, whether that's through interactive tooling, ML pipelines, or scalable backend infrastructure. I care about solutions that are not just technically sound but actually useful to the people relying on them.

Always building. Always learning.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed and implemented cross-platform GUIs using Python (PyQt6) to interface with multiple embedded instruments, streamline hardware testing, and enable dynamic data visualization across local drives and networked systems – automating workflows and supporting data capture.
- Spearheaded the development of containerized React web application that enables users to visualize and search complex test data, integrating FastAPI backend server with MariaDB database. Supported on the optimization of database queries, database / backend architecture and performance testing to reduce latency and improve throughput as data scales. 
- Collaborated on data pipeline into ElasticSearch using Python API to aggregate logs for web application and utilized Kibana to create lightweight dashboard to track website traffic which provides meaningful metrics and debugging tools.
- Implemented MLFlow into core software for MLOps use cases to support tracking, recording derive deep insights into ML models.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed and implemented Python-based Graphical User Interface (GUI) applications to streamline testing operations, enhancing multi-instrument connectivity and facilitating data-driven decision-making across programs.
- Developed a Python package for interfacing with microchips and supporting hardware, optimizing machine learning metrics and performance by supporting the efficient execution of machine learning models directly on chip.
- Utilized Tableau, MariaDB, and Python to enhance data pipelines and create dynamic visualizations of microchip testing metrics, providing actionable insights for stakeholders and improving functional test analysis.
Facilitated the migration of data analysis functions from MATLAB to Python (using Numpy and Polars), significantly advancing analytical capabilities and achieving greater integration of data systems.
- Managed source control and documentation using GitHub/GitLab and Jira, ensuring version control and traceability of code changes while adhering to Agile best practices for enhanced collaboration and project management.
- Implemented advanced debugging techniques in MATLAB to improve Port Forwarding Networking capabilities, streamlining testing workflows and developing automated batch scripts to enhance testing reliability and security in the lab environment.

positions.title: Academic Technology Services Intern
positions.locationName: Manhattan, New York, United States · Remote
positions.description:
•	Assisted the Office of Academic Technology Services to support, use and integrate teaching and learning tools into course development projects by creating responsive and functional course designs that follow Disability and Academic Standards using HTML and CSS code design. 
•	Collaborated and corresponded with professors to gain insight and direction for desired course design and implemented unified action plan with the guidance of management supporting documentation
•	Educated and guided management and co-workers on effective HTML and CSS code development by repairing and implementing code design that encourages repeatability through the guidance of video and written instruction.

positions.title: Firmware Engineer
positions.description:
- Engineered PCB circuit schematic and layout facilitating seamless communication between the Rockwell Test Fixture and NI DAQ, meticulously reviewing schematics and conducting rigorous hardware testing of the self-soldered PCB to mitigate noise interference and loading issues effectively.
- Developed a user-friendly Graphic User Interface (GUI) within a tight deadline of 3 weeks using Python and employing multithreading concepts, thereby optimizing testing methodologies for Rockwell Products.
- Implemented an automated testing framework significantly enhancing efficiency in both time and space utilization.
- Designed and implemented a robust communication network utilizing Python to enhance the User Experience (UX/UI) of previous hard integration testing methods, involving DC Power Supply, NI Measurement Cards, and Rockwell products, replacing cumbersome Putty-based approaches.
- Provided comprehensive visual and written documentation to support future development ensuring clarity and ease of maintenance.
- Leveraged Agile methodologies, particularly the Scrum Framework, to enhance collaboration and efficiency within firmware team
- Collaborated with a Senior Firmware Engineer to analyze a firmware repository, focusing on the integration and implementation of C/C++ on diverse microcontrollers like STM32G081, exploring their features such as DAC, I2C, SPI, USART, UART, and DMA for optimized functionality.

projects.title: NYC Accident Severity Prediction and Hotspot Analysis
projects.description:
- Designed and implemented a RandomForestClassifier with 100 estimators in Python, leveraging multi-class classification techniques to accurately predict NYC accident severity and borough locations.
- Developed comprehensive geospatial visualizations using Folium to create dynamic, interactive heat-maps of NYC accident hotspots, optimizing map performance for large datasets and enabling in-depth location analysis.
- Applied extensive data cleaning and preprocessing techniques, handling data imputation, normalization, and integration, to ensure high-quality, reliable data inputs for machine learning model training and analysis.
- Optimized multi-classification model performance by rebalancing dataset using SMOTE, fine-tuning RandomForestClassifier parameters, enhancing model accuracy in predicting accident severity and geographic distribution.

projects.title: AI-Powered Wildlife Deterrence System for Agriculture
projects.description:
- Developed a TensorFlow Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) model deployed on a Raspberry Pi 4 to detect and classify wildlife for crop protection, applying data preprocessing, model training, and performance tuning.
- Led data-driven project presentations and explained complex model architecture, showcasing expertise in CNN model design, data analysis, and deployment in real-world environments.
- Conducted extensive data testing and evaluation across varied wildlife scenarios, refining model accuracy and robustness, and optimizing detection performance through iterative analysis and fine-tuning.
